inspiration: One world, several tile sizes: the same game ships 8x8, 8x16, 16x16, 32x32 and 64x64 tile sets, each in its own folder with a small mapping file that assigns tiles to game entities (lib/tiles/list.txt; lib/tiles/*/graf-*.prf). Recreate: a swappable art layer that maps entity ids to sprite cells, so a new style is a data change.

Palette by name: visuals.txt defines 28 named colour indices with a one-letter code, plus a legacy colour-cycle (flicker) that only monsters use. Recreate: a named palette with a small set of cycle rules for glowing or shimmering monsters, rather than per-sprite recolour.

Glyph plus colour as the readable base: terrain.txt pairs each terrain type with one symbol and one colour (for example a dot for floor, a plus for door). Recreate: keep a readable silhouette per tile type first, then add a colour code, so the map reads at a glance.

Monsters as short data rows: a monster entry is a glyph, a colour, speed, hit points, a bite or breath attack, a flag set and one line of flavour text (monster.txt around line 1886). Recreate: a compact creature card that the art team can draw from.

Sound by family prefix: file names group ambience (amb_), monster calls (mco_), player combat (plc_) and player misc such as coins, chests and doors (plm_). Recreate: the same prefix scheme with our own recordings, so the audio pack can be browsed by role.

Depth-tiered ambience: sound.prf maps the day, night and dungeon ambient slots to different loops (thunder, guitar chord, iron door and bells). Recreate: bells and gongs underground, rain and thunder above, using original recordings.

Player shapes: shape.txt describes form changes that modify combat, skills and resistances, plus their own effects and messages. Recreate: a transform system that is mainly a stat package and a visual swap, not a new character sheet.

briefs.label: Frost-drip swarm insect (own label)
briefs.why: Small, fast, pale and cold-themed: reads as a nuisance that becomes a threat in numbers. Based on the file's name, colour code and one-line description, not on the sprite (not opened).
change: insect body with crystalline wings instead of plain wings
icy spine ornament and a different palette

briefs.label: Elemental dragon family (own label)
briefs.why: A tiered family where each member shares a body plan and changes only by element colour. Read from the monster.txt entries, sprite not opened.
keep: one body plan across a family
young and adult forms as separate rows
change: scale pattern instead of plain plates
our own element names and palette ramps

briefs.label: Dark-fantasy 64px original tile set (own label)
briefs.why: A large, high-detail tile set reads well at a bigger scale. The donor set itself is restrictive, so only the scale idea is taken; the art must be drawn from scratch.
keep: one sheet with a matching prf map
change: original subjects, not the donor's tile list

briefs.label: Bell and gong underground ambience (own label)

keep: metallic bell and gong loops for depth
change: tied to our own zone table
